name: remode
description: Remode fashion shopping assistant for Grok via Remode's hosted MCP server. Find clothing, shoes, bags and accessories from a photo link or a description, compare one product's price across shops and second-hand, and start Hunts that keep watching an exact item for a lower price, a restock or a second-hand listing. Searching needs no account; Hunts ask you to sign in to Remode.
